# hUGEDriver

This directory vendors the hUGEDriver source used by Sixies' title track.
It is public domain and originates from hUGEDriver 1.0.11, bundled with
hUGETracker 1.0.11. Its RGBDS-to-SDCC converter requires the pinned RGBDS
0.6.1 assembler installed by `scripts/setup-tools.sh`. The original source is at
https://github.com/SuperDisk/hUGEDriver.
